newsitem.title: USA: Salomon named advisor by Dominican electric co.
newsitem.headline: Salomon named advisor by Dominican electric co.

text.p: Salomon Brothers said Thursday it has been named financial advisor by the Corporacion Dominicana de Electricidad, which is restructuring the Dominican Republic's electricity sector.

Salomon, a unit of Salomon Inc, said the restructuring follows the successsful Bolivian model in which public entities were capitalized to incorporate private capital and management into the created companies.
Salomon said the Dominican company plans to organize the country's electricity sector into three distribution, one transmission and three generation companies.
For regulatory purposes, the country will use the Chilean model, Salomon said.
